concurrency: Read-only and re-entrant; concurrent readers observe the same bytes; no writes occur.
inputs: existing run root and its manifest/stream/artifacts
outputs: records, diagnostics and declared metric-input links
purpose: Provide a bounded read-only reader that verifies manifest and artifact hashes and returns records, diagnostics and declared metric-input links through deterministic JSON/JSONL export, with no execution, metric computation, oracle or control output.
state: Owns no writable state; reads and verifies existing evidence and holds only a bounded in-memory export buffer.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; the reader is read-only and exposes no metric/oracle/socket/subprocess call
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned reader/cli sources plus a check that the reader opens files read-only, selection is by ingestionOrdinal, and no metric computation, oracle, socket or subprocess call exists
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

static_checks.expected: ast analysis finds pre-I/O confinement checks, bounded streaming reads, caller-authoritative limit selection, both recorded/assessed status fields, and defensive copy on every returned view
static_checks.rule: the reader resolves and lstat-checks confined paths before I/O, streams the manifest/stream/lines under caller finite bounds without materializing the whole file, treats the caller limits as authoritative over any manifest echo, exposes recorded and assessed status separately, and returns defensive copies
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-010-U unit specification - Bounded read-only replay/export and metric-input links

unit_cases.expected: records are returned in strictly increasing ingestionOrdinal order, deterministically
unit_cases.precondition: a finalized run with events appended out of clock order

unit_cases.expected: the two exports are byte-equal canonical JSON
unit_cases.precondition: an unchanged finalized run

unit_cases.expected: the two exports are byte-equal canonical JSONL with identical record ordering
unit_cases.precondition: an unchanged finalized run

unit_cases.expected: the manifest and every indexed artifact size/hash verify and no diagnostic is produced
unit_cases.precondition: an intact finalized run with an indexed artifact

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CORRUPT-ARTIFACT-HASH plus a bounded partial result of the records read so far; no invented data and no silent truncation
unit_cases.precondition: an indexed artifact whose bytes were mutated

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED plus the first max_read_records records; the run root is not written
unit_cases.precondition: a run holding more records than the caller max_read_records

unit_cases.expected: each entry carries metricId, observerIds, calculationRef, unitSemantics, timeDomainIds and a declared selection of artifact paths/event ids; no metric value is computed
unit_cases.precondition: a plan body declaring metrics with observer references

unit_cases.expected: the incomplete selection is reported explicitly and never filled in or guessed
unit_cases.precondition: a declared metric observer reference with no matching captured selection

unit_cases.expected: no component, fault, lifecycle action, metric computation, evaluation oracle, subprocess or network call is invoked
unit_cases.precondition: a finalized run read with socket/subprocess access made unavailable

unit_cases.expected: usage-free JSON summary is printed; exit 0 for complete, exit 1 for incomplete/corrupt, exit 2 for a usage/input error
unit_cases.precondition: a complete run and an incomplete/corrupt run

unit_cases.expected: stdout bytes equal the corresponding API export
unit_cases.precondition: a finalized run

unit_cases.expected: every run-root file hash is unchanged after the read/export
unit_cases.precondition: a finalized run
unit_cases.stimulus: record every file hash, read and export, then re-hash

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-PATH-ESCAPE before any open or parse; no bytes are read from outside the run root and the original bytes are unchanged (ARGUS2-ADV-01)
unit_cases.precondition: a manifest field (manifest/eventStream/artifact path) containing a '..' segment, an absolute path or a drive-like prefix

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-PATH-SYMLINK before any read; the link target is never followed and no O_NOFOLLOW-refused file is parsed (ARGUS2-ADV-01)
unit_cases.precondition: the manifest.json, stream or indexed artifact path is a symlink, including one resolving inside the run root

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-PATH-NOT-REGULAR before any parse; nothing is read and no partial record is trusted (ARGUS2-ADV-01)
unit_cases.precondition: the manifest, stream or indexed artifact path is a directory, FIFO, device or socket

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_manifest_bytes; the partial bytes are not parsed and the original manifest bytes are unchanged (ARGUS2-ADV-02)
unit_cases.precondition: a manifest file larger than the caller max_manifest_bytes

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_event_bytes; the over-long line is not parsed and the records before it form a bounded partial result (ARGUS2-ADV-02)
unit_cases.precondition: a stream line longer than the caller max_event_bytes

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-BOUND-EXCEEDED naming max_events; the read stops at the derived total stream bound and the run root is not written (ARGUS2-ADV-02)
unit_cases.precondition: a stream whose byte length exceeds the derived total bound max_events * max_event_bytes

unit_cases.expected: the caller limits govern verification; the echoed limits are recorded data only and never relax a bound, and an unparseable echo is a diagnostic rather than a new limit set (ARGUS2-ADV-02)
unit_cases.precondition: a damaged manifest echoing a huge limits object while the caller passes small explicit limits

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CORRUPT-MANIFEST-SHAPE as a stable bounded diagnostic; the container is never coerced, iterated or indexed assuming the wrong type and the assessed status is incomplete (ARGUS2-ADV-05)
unit_cases.precondition: a manifest that is not a JSON object, or whose artifacts/obligations/eventStream member has a scalar/array type where the frozen type requires another shape

unit_cases.expected: ARGUS2-CORRUPT-EVENT as a stable bounded diagnostic; the record is excluded and the assessed status is incomplete (ARGUS2-ADV-05)
unit_cases.precondition: a stream line that parses to a JSON array, scalar, string or null

unit_cases.expected: exit 1 with an output carrying both recorded and assessed facts for the corrupt run; exit 0 only when assessedEvidenceStatus is 'complete' (ARGUS2-ADV-03)
unit_cases.precondition: a manifest that recorded 'complete' while verification detects corruption, and a genuinely complete run

unit_cases.expected: an assessed incomplete result with no records and a bounded stable diagnostic; no manifest is synthesized and the original bytes are unchanged (ARGUS2-ADV-03)
unit_cases.precondition: a manifest that cannot be read or parsed at all

unit_cases.expected: internal admission facts and the second read/export are unchanged because every returned view is an independent defensive copy (ARGUS2-ADV-07)
unit_cases.precondition: an intact finalized run read twice
unit_cases.stimulus: mutate any nested object reachable from records()/manifest/metric_inputs() returned by the first read, then export again
